content_of_post_to_answer: Why does mental clarity feel so difficult when you have too many thoughts at once?
answer: Mental clarity often feels difficult because the mind is not actually failing; it is trying to process too many unresolved signals at the same time. A useful distinction is between having many thoughts and having many open loops—one creates noise, the other creates cognitive weight. I’ve explored this pattern in more detail on my Quora profile for those who want to go deeper. Clarity rarely comes from forcing the mind to stop thinking; it comes from knowing which thoughts deserve attention and which ones are simply asking to be released.
